posts.title: Mistral publicly releases Large 4 for cybersecurity
posts.excerpt: Mistral released Large 4 to the public Thursday, built to help organisations find and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities. Anyone can download it and run it on their own systems instead of going…
posts.body: [Mistral released Large 4 to the public Thursday](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/mistral-ai-publicly-releases-large-4-targets-cybersecurity-users-2026-10-29/), built to help organisations find and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities. Anyone can download it and run it on their own systems instead of going through a third-party online service.

posts.title: Fed holds rates steady in 10-2 vote
posts.excerpt: Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented from the decision to hold rates steady, preferring an immediate 0.25-percentage-point increase. The October 28 vote was 10-2,…
posts.body: Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented from the decision to [hold rates steady](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/us-fed-holds-interest-rates-steady-despite-surging-inflation-6500656), preferring an immediate 0.25-percentage-point increase. The October 28 vote was 10-2, keeping the target range at 3.75% to 4.00%.

posts.title: Jailbroken PS5s can now run Steam games
posts.excerpt: Playden runs Windows games from a Steam library locally on a jailbroken PS5, using the console's own hardware instead of streaming from a PC. It is still in alpha, and games requiring kernel-level…
posts.body: [Playden](https://nextgenupdate.com/articles/402/jailbroken-ps5-consoles-can-now-run-steam-games-heres-how-it-works) runs Windows games from a Steam library locally on a jailbroken PS5, using the console's own hardware instead of streaming from a PC. It is still in alpha, and games requiring kernel-level anti-cheat or third-party launchers are generally unsupported.

posts.title: SpaceX tests Ship 42 ahead of November Flight 15
posts.excerpt: SpaceX ran Ship 42 through a static fire of all six Raptor engines, including a simulated deorbit burn. Flight 15 will try to catch both the Ship and its Super Heavy booster at Starbase in Texas.
posts.body: SpaceX [ran Ship 42 through a static fire](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/spacex-tests-ship-42-upper-stage-before-november-flight-15/tldr) of all six Raptor engines, including a simulated deorbit burn. Flight 15 will try to catch both the Ship and its Super Heavy booster at Starbase in Texas.

posts.title: Coursera check finds no child-safety certificate
posts.excerpt: A repaired check of Coursera's 298 Professional Certificates opened 24 detail pages and found none teaching child safety reporting, NCMEC reporting, or hash matching, with enrolled course content and…
posts.body: A repaired check of Coursera's 298 Professional Certificates opened 24 detail pages and found none teaching child safety reporting, NCMEC reporting, or hash matching, with enrolled course content and non-English variants unchecked. The closest match was Meta Community Management, which teaches community guidelines and structured moderation.

posts.title: ORR adviser on finding missing children and addressing fraud
posts.excerpt: John Fabbricatore, ORR's special adviser discussed the effort to locate children placed with sponsors without adequate vetting and to improve sponsor vetting. He also described thousands of notices…
posts.body: [John Fabbricatore, ORR's special adviser](https://cis.org/Parsing-Immigration-Policy/Finding-Missing-Children-and-Addressing-Immigration-Fraud) discussed the effort to locate children placed with sponsors without adequate vetting and to improve sponsor vetting. He also described thousands of notices of concern, including reports of possible trafficking, abuse, sexual abuse and medical emergencies.

posts.title: Muscles may grow more after an exercise break
posts.excerpt: Retraining after a four-week break built up to 30% more leg muscle in mice than training once, even though the mice averaged 6 kilometers a day the second time against 10 kilometers a day the first.…
posts.body: [Retraining after a four-week break](https://knowridge.com/2026/10/muscles-may-grow-more-after-an-exercise-break-mouse-study-finds/) built up to 30% more leg muscle in mice than training once, even though the mice averaged 6 kilometers a day the second time against 10 kilometers a day the first. Genes tied to mitochondrial function became much more active during retraining, suggesting the first bout primed the muscles to respond again.

posts.title: Early voting ends Friday, October 30
posts.excerpt: You have through Friday, October 30, to vote early in Texas for the November 3, 2026, general election. Polling places will be open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Election Day.
posts.body: You have through Friday, October 30, to [vote early](https://texasborderbusiness.com/election-day-approaches-as-early-voting-begins-october-19-across-texas/) in Texas for the November 3, 2026, general election. Polling places will be open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Election Day.

posts.title: New Connected Apps Platform launches for developers
posts.excerpt: The preview of Google's Connected Apps Platform gives developers one route into both Search and the Gemini app. Developers connect through a cloud-hosted MCP server or Android MCP using the…
posts.body: The preview of [Google's Connected Apps Platform](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/connected-apps-one-place) gives developers one route into both Search and the Gemini app. Developers connect through a cloud-hosted MCP server or Android MCP using the AppFunctions APIs, then register, test, and submit through the Google Connected Console.

posts.title: Prolapse exploit works on PS5 firmware 14.10
posts.excerpt: Sony patched the flaw in firmware 14.20, released October 21. The hypervisor bypass needed to run game backups still stops at 13.60, so a bootable GTA 6 backup looks unlikely when it arrives November…
posts.body: Sony [patched the flaw in firmware 14.20](https://news.lavx.hu/article/ps5-kernel-exploit-prolapse-works-on-firmware-14-10-but-gta-6-piracy-remains-unlikely-for-now), released October 21. The hypervisor bypass needed to run game backups still stops at 13.60, so a bootable GTA 6 backup looks unlikely when it arrives November 19.

posts.title: CSA launches STAR for AI Level 2 certification
posts.excerpt: STAR for AI Level 2 adds third-party-verified AI assurance to the Cloud Security Alliance's STAR program, alongside traditional cloud certification. The designation combines independent certification…
posts.body: [STAR for AI Level 2](https://cloudsecurityalliance.org/press-releases/2026/10/27/cloud-security-alliance-launches-star-for-ai-level-2-to-strengthen-ai-governance-and-trust) adds third-party-verified AI assurance to the Cloud Security Alliance's STAR program, alongside traditional cloud certification. The designation combines independent certification with automated analysis through Valid-AI-ted, aligned with the alliance's AI Controls Matrix.

posts.title: Vanguard Academy plans $94M expansion across three Valley cities
posts.excerpt: Vanguard Academy plans an estimated $94 million in school construction across Pharr, Alamo and Mission, with all three facilities expected to open in 2027. The first phase in Pharr is a $28 million…
posts.body: [Vanguard Academy](https://www.rgvbusinessjournal.com/news/27/10/2026/vanguard-academy-plans-94m-in-projects-across-three-valley-cities/) plans an estimated $94 million in school construction across Pharr, Alamo and Mission, with all three facilities expected to open in 2027. posts.body: [GitHub Copilot Fusion](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-route-and-orchestrate-models-with-github-copilot-fusion/) is generally available, so Copilot chooses and orchestrates the models for each task instead of you switching models mid-task. Paid Copilot plans get a limited-time 30% discount on model costs when using it.

posts.title: Supreme Court denies judges the power to pause deportation cases
posts.excerpt: The Supreme Court declined Tuesday to reinstate immigration judges' authority to temporarily postpone deportation cases. Administrative closure had let judges clear cases from active dockets while a…
posts.body: The Supreme Court [declined Tuesday to reinstate](https://www.reuters.com/world/us-supreme-court-denies-immigration-judges-power-shelve-deportation-cases-2026-10-27/) immigration judges' authority to temporarily postpone deportation cases. Administrative closure had let judges clear cases from active dockets while a visa petition or an appeal of a criminal conviction was still pending.

posts.title: Eco's Sauce kit keeps AI agents inside operator-set limits
posts.excerpt: Eco launched Sauce SDK on Wednesday, letting developers write transaction conditions in TypeScript. If a transaction cannot satisfy every condition when it runs, it never executes and no funds move.
posts.body: [Eco launched Sauce SDK](https://unchainedcrypto.com/ecos-new-sauce-developer-kit-keeps-ai-agents-transactions-within-operator-set-limits/) on Wednesday, letting developers write transaction conditions in TypeScript. If a transaction cannot satisfy every condition when it runs, it never executes and no funds move.

posts.title: Judge pauses rule cutting refugee reply window to 10 days
posts.excerpt: District Judge Julia Kobick on October 27 barred DHS and USCIS from enforcing the rule through November 6. The stay also freezes the short-deadline notices sent since October 14, so recipients do not…
posts.body: District Judge Julia Kobick on October 27 [barred DHS and USCIS from enforcing the rule](https://immigration-analytics.com/2026/10/28/refugee-status-termination-rule-paused/) through November 6. The stay also freezes the short-deadline notices sent since October 14, so recipients do not have to respond while it lasts.

posts.title: SK hynix sees memory shortage lasting through 2030
posts.excerpt: SK hynix expects memory demand to exceed supply through 2030, in third-quarter 2026 results announced October 28. Long-term agreements with 14 major customers already cover more than 50% of its…
posts.body: SK hynix [expects memory demand to exceed supply through 2030](https://www.tweaktown.com/news/114347/sk-hynix-warns-the-memory-shortage-will-last-through-2030-as-ai-demand-keeps-growing/index.html), in third-quarter 2026 results announced October 28. Long-term agreements with 14 major customers already cover more than 50% of its production capacity for 2027 and 2028.

posts.title: Amazon discourages tokenmaxxing as AI costs climb
posts.excerpt: Amazon's guidelines, published October 27, call token consumption, AI adoption rates, and code changes "deeply flawed" ways to judge teams. The company shut down an internal usage leaderboard in May…
posts.body: [Amazon's guidelines](https://indianexpress.com/article/technology/tech-news-technology/amazon-discourages-tokenmaxxing-ai-usage-costs-10940049/), published October 27, call token consumption, AI adoption rates, and code changes "deeply flawed" ways to judge teams. The company shut down an internal usage leaderboard in May after employees inflated their usage to climb the rankings.

posts.title: AMD, Meta expand deal to power superintelligence infrastructure
posts.excerpt: AMD's initial Helios rack-scale systems are installed and being tested at Meta on the path to a broader deployment. Behind Meta's Muse personal AI agent are the dedicated computing environments AMD…

The slow group gained the most quadriceps size while lowering a full one-repetition maximum for five seconds.

posts.title: Jailbroken PS5 can play PS2 discs, but loses PSN
posts.excerpt: PS5SX2 offers 4K upscaling, widescreen support, 60fps patches and HD texture packs for PS2 discs on a jailbroken console. The catch is that Relapse works only up to system software 13.60, and staying…
posts.body: [PS5SX2](https://www.engadget.com/2295693/a-jailbroken-playstation-5-can-play-ps2-discs-but-sony-is-giving-users-a-tough-choice/) offers 4K upscaling, widescreen support, 60fps patches and HD texture packs for PS2 discs on a jailbroken console. The catch is that Relapse works only up to system software 13.60, and staying there costs PlayStation Network, the PlayStation Store and newer games requiring recent firmware.

posts.title: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 world simulation
posts.excerpt: Genie 4 simultaneously generates music, ambient noises, and interactive dialogue alongside the simulated world. It remains a research preview for trusted testers, with access coming soon to Google AI…
posts.body: Genie 4 [simultaneously generates music, ambient noises, and interactive dialogue](https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-4-a-new-generation-of-world-simulation/) alongside the simulated world. It remains a research preview for trusted testers, with access coming soon to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners in the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

posts.title: SpaceX employs more than 4,000 in the Valley, most of them locals
posts.excerpt: As SpaceX expanded its production and launch facility near Brownsville, analysis by the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas showed lower unemployment, higher wages, and an uptick in home and retail sales,…
posts.body: As SpaceX expanded its production and launch facility near Brownsville, [analysis by the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas](http://www.marketplace.org/story/2026/10/27/how-spacex-is-changing-the-rio-grande-valley-economy) showed lower unemployment, higher wages, and an uptick in home and retail sales, though how much is attributable to SpaceX is unclear. SpaceX now employs more than 4,000 people, most of them locals, according to the company's website, after billions in capital investment.

posts.title: Terra bills long prompts at double past 272K tokens
posts.excerpt: Requests over 272,000 input tokens are billed at twice the input and cache rates and 1.5 times the output rate for the whole request. In a worked example with 10 million input tokens, 97% of them…
posts.body: Requests over [272,000 input tokens](https://theainewsreport.com/2026-10-27-gpt-6-1-terra-pricing-agent-cost-explained.html) are billed at twice the input and cache rates and 1.5 times the output rate for the whole request. In a worked example with 10 million input tokens, 97% of them cache reads, Terra cost $1.79 against $4.94 for GPT-5.6 Terra.

posts.title: SBA clarifies 7(a) acquisition rules
posts.excerpt: The SBA clarified that people who have not been employees for 24 months cannot become the largest shareholder in an employee buyout. More than 250 lenders are testing the Intelligent Capital Access…
posts.body: The SBA clarified that [people who have not been employees for 24 months](https://colemanreport.com/sba-hot-topic-tuesday-sba-clarifies-acquisition-rules-corrects-7a-guaranty-fees-and-expands-icap/) cannot become the largest shareholder in an employee buyout. More than 250 lenders are testing the Intelligent Capital Access Platform, which provides earlier eligibility and fraud checks.

posts.title: Texas suspended 17 data center permits after auto-approvals
posts.excerpt: Texas regulators suspended 17 data center permits after watchdogs showed the STEERS portal kept approving projects following Governor Abbott's September 21 pause. The suspended permits are stormwater…
posts.body: Texas regulators [suspended 17 data center permits](https://hwbusters.com/news/texas-data-center-permits-kept-auto-approving-after-abbotts-pause-and-17-are-now-suspended/) after watchdogs showed the STEERS portal kept approving projects following Governor Abbott's September 21 pause. The suspended permits are stormwater construction authorizations, the paperwork that lets a developer start grading and leveling a site.

posts.title: Super Heavy tested for Flight 15
posts.excerpt: SpaceX completed a full-duration, 33-engine static fire of the Super Heavy booster for Flight 15 on October 25 at Starbase, Texas. The six-engine Starship upper stage still has its own full-duration…
posts.body: SpaceX completed a [full-duration, 33-engine static fire](https://aviationweek.com/space/launch-vehicles-propulsion/super-heavy-tested-flight-15) of the Super Heavy booster for Flight 15 on October 25 at Starbase, Texas. The six-engine Starship upper stage still has its own full-duration static firing pending.

posts.title: More protein stops helping past 1.6g per kilo
posts.excerpt: A review of 49 trials found protein supplements added muscle size and strength when people were already doing resistance training. Without that training, the supplement alone did not improve muscle…
posts.body: A [review of 49 trials](https://the-14.com/protein-can-help-build-and-preserve-muscle-but-eating-more-has-its-limits/) found protein supplements added muscle size and strength when people were already doing resistance training. Without that training, the supplement alone did not improve muscle size or strength in a year-long trial of older adults.

posts.title: Google expands AI agent kit to five languages
posts.excerpt: Every version speaks Model Context Protocol and Agent2Agent, so a tool built once as an MCP server can be called from any of the five languages. Kotlin agents can run on-device on Android, using…
posts.body: Every version speaks [Model Context Protocol and Agent2Agent](https://channellife.com.au/story/google-expands-ai-agent-kit-to-five-languages), so a tool built once as an MCP server can be called from any of the five languages. Kotlin agents can run on-device on Android, using LiteRT-LM and ML Kit without a network connection.

posts.title: PS3 games run on jailbroken PS5, NFS Carbon hits 60 FPS
posts.excerpt: Jailbroken PS5 consoles can now run PS3 games through native RPCS3 builds that drop the Linux layer earlier attempts needed. There is no installable package yet, with KB-RPCS3 shipping as source code…
posts.body: Jailbroken PS5 consoles can now [run PS3 games through native RPCS3 builds](https://tech-insider.org/ps3-games-on-ps5-rpcs3-kb-rpcs3-jailbreak-2026/) that drop the Linux layer earlier attempts needed. There is no installable package yet, with KB-RPCS3 shipping as source code and build instructions only.

posts.body: It is available now to Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users in [ChatGPT Work and Codex](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/openai-launches-gpt-6-1-terra-for-faster-better-performing-ai-agents-at-half-the-price/). posts.title: PC shipments fell 20.1% in Q3 2026
posts.excerpt: Only 62.7 million desktops, notebooks, and workstations shipped in the third quarter, a 20.1 percent decline from a year earlier, according to preliminary figures from IDC. AI data centers are…
posts.body: Only 62.7 million desktops, notebooks, and workstations shipped in the third quarter, a 20.1 percent decline from a year earlier, according to [preliminary figures from IDC](https://basic-tutorials.com/news/pc-market-plummets-20-percent-in-the-third-quarter-of-2026/). AI data centers are absorbing much of the DRAM and NAND production that would otherwise go into PCs.

posts.body: GitHub says the model is built for everyday agentic coding and terminal work at a lower cost than GPT-6.1 Sol, per [GitHub](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-26-gpt-6-1-terra-in-github-copilot/). It is open to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users, with a gradual rollout.

posts.title: Samsung Display faces profit squeeze as Apple, Samsung cut orders
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 26, 2026, 6:14 PM; Samsung Electronics and Apple are scaling back smartphone component orders as soaring memory prices squeeze margins, threatening Samsung Display's fourth-quarter…
posts.body: Published Oct 26, 2026, 6:14 PM; Samsung Electronics and Apple are scaling back smartphone component orders as soaring memory prices squeeze margins, threatening [Samsung Display's](https://m.koreaherald.com/article/10914960) fourth-quarter earnings. Samsung's mobile division asked suppliers to trim fourth-quarter component deliveries by 20 to 30 percent, while Apple cut October orders for certain iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max parts by 15 to 20 percent.

posts.title: Jailbroken PS5 consoles can now run Steam games
posts.excerpt: Playden, a new experimental homebrew launcher, lets jailbroken PlayStation 5 consoles load certain Steam games locally without booting into Linux, per KitGuru. Older or less demanding titles such as…
posts.body: Playden, a new experimental homebrew launcher, lets jailbroken PlayStation 5 consoles load certain Steam games locally without booting into Linux, per [KitGuru](https://www.kitguru.net/gaming/joao-silva/jailbroken-ps5-consoles-can-now-run-steam-games/). Older or less demanding titles such as Portal, Half-Life 2 and Fallout: New Vegas appear among the more reliable options, while newer games and anything needing kernel-level anti-cheat often fail to launch.

posts.title: Valley manufacturers need more skilled workers to fuel growth
posts.excerpt: A manufacturing roundtable hosted by the Pharr Economic Development Corp. examined how the Valley can prepare for an industry increasingly shaped by automation and artificial intelligence.…
posts.body: A [manufacturing roundtable hosted by the Pharr Economic Development Corp.](https://www.rgvbusinessjournal.com/news/26/10/2026/rgv-manufacturing-workforce-shortage-expansion-article/) examined how the Valley can prepare for an industry increasingly shaped by automation and artificial intelligence. Manufacturing accounts for about 4% of the Valley's economy, leaving a limited pool of experienced workers as companies expand, according to Mike Willis of the South Texas Manufacturers Association.
